requirements.quote: Send two ICMP echo-requests to 127.0.0.1, and write the full, untouched command output into a new file called `/home/user/network_diagnostics/ping_localhost.log`.
The final statistics line (the one that contains “packet loss”) must include the substring “0% packet loss”.

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import re,sys
ls=[l for l in open('"'"'/home/user/network_diagnostics/ping_localhost.log'"'"').read().splitlines() if '"'"'packet loss'"'"' in l]
sys.exit(0 if ls and re.search(r'"'"'(^|[^0-9.])0% packet loss'"'"',ls[-1]) else 1)'

requirements.quote: The very last line in the file must start with “rtt” (or “round-trip”) and contain the four latency numbers separated by “/”.
